title: Italian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Italian-inspired stew made with Croatian sausage, tender potatoes, and rich vegetables.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the Croatian sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the diced potatoes, canned tomatoes, red wine (if using), and dried basil. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25-30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh basil if desired.
